supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-claimsync logon failures occurred on FILE-HD-01 from 13:33 through 13:48 UTC. The failures report an incorrect password and identify FILE-HD-01 as the workstation; the corresponding domain-controller records also show credential failures.

The roughly minute-spaced failures originating from FILE-HD-01 are consistent with the supplied inventory's every-minute ClaimSync re-authentication and the scheduled 13:30 UTC password rotation, but the logs do not confirm that this benign explanation is the cause.

At 14:07 UTC, WS-OHADDAD-01 recorded a SYSTEM process, GxCVD.exe, supplying svc-claimsync credentials to PROXY-HD-01. This is an unusual use of the ClaimSync service account and is not explained by the supplied inventory, but this event alone does not establish that authentication succeeded or that the activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a successful authentication result or proxy logs showing whether the 14:07 credential attempt succeeded.
No password-rotation, ClaimSync job-update, process execution lineage, command-line, or file-integrity evidence was supplied.
The available records are limited to the listed events; they do not establish whether other relevant activity occurred during the review window.

Whether the repeated failures were solely caused by the scheduled rotation rather than another cause.
